program.name: Core Volume
program.subject: Core & abs
program.blurb: Three core days: resisting the arch, twisting and resisting the twist, then hollows and loaded work.
program.about: The whole core across three days. Planks, body saws and dead bugs teach the trunk not to arch; woodchops, side planks and twists train it to turn and to stop turning; hollow holds and weighted work finish the cycle. Straight sets throughout. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
